description_en: Modifies a bound Alibaba Cloud account
description_zh: 修改已经绑定的云账号
kebab_example: aliyun cloud-siem modify-bind-account --bind-id 123 --account-id 123xxxxxxx --cloud-code hcloud --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2022-06-16 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyBindAccount

parameters.help_en: The AccessKey ID of the Alibaba Cloud account
parameters.name: access_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the multicloud account
parameters.name: account_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the binding record. This is the BindId value returned by the ListBindAccount operation
parameters.name: bind_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account
parameters.name: account_id

parameters.help_en: The code of the multicloud service
parameters.name: cloud_code

parameters.help_en:
The region where the Data Management center for threat analysis is located. Select a region based on the location of your assets. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: Your assets are in the Chinese mainland or China (Hong Kong).

ap-southeast-1: Your assets are outside China
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地与中国香港
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The user ID of the member. An administrator can specify this parameter to switch to the member's view
parameters.help_zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID
parameters.name: role_for

parameters.help_en:
The view type.

0: The view of the current Alibaba Cloud account.

1: The view of all accounts in the enterprise
parameters.help_zh:
视图类型。

0：当前阿里云账号视图。
1：企业下所有账号的视图
parameters.name: role_type

Data.description_en: The return value of the request

Count.description_en: The number of account bindings that are modified. A value of 1 indicates that the operation is successful. A value of 0 or less indicates that the operation failed
Count.description_zh: 修改账号绑定的数量，等于1表示成功，小于等于0表示失败
Count.title_zh: 修改账号绑定的数量，等于1表示成功，小于等于0表示失败。
